description: The fungus steers the elk now. Its antlers bloom green in the dark, sowing spores wherever it grieves.
lore: Sporehorn keeps a circuit. [[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] walked it out over two winters — he maps ground that will not hold still, and an animal that repeats itself was a rest — and got three stops: a ford, a burnt orchard, and a bare slope above the orchard with nothing on it at all. It stands at the ford a while. At the orchard a while. At the bare slope until the light goes.

There was a hut on that slope. Gunnar asked eleven people before he found one who could still say so, and she could not produce the woman's name — only that she kept goats and fed whatever came to the door, elk included. The hut is not there now, nor the track up to it. Things nobody tells about [[lore/the_quiet|go soft, and then go]], and that elk is the last thing in the world that still turns up.

The fungus did not pick the route. It has only worked out where the elk stands longest, and standing still is the whole of what a fungus wants. The right antler is green through and wet with it; the left is still an elk's. The mushrooms come up thickest on the withers, the flat of the back, where you would put your hand on an animal to steady it. Gunnar's map marks the roads between as bad ground and will not say why. He says Sporehorn is no danger where it stops. It is a danger on the way, and he would rather people were not standing in the road when it goes to see about her.
gm_notes: Shipped description adopted verbatim — 'wherever it grieves' is the best word in the roster and the whole record is built to earn it. Art: brown elk, only the right antler taken (green, glowing, dripping), pale mushrooms fruiting on the withers, ribs showing through an open flank, green eye. Half of it is still an elk, and that is the point. The load-bearing invention is the woman on the slope: she went Quiet because nobody kept telling about her, and the animal's habit outlasted every human keeping in the district. Do not let a player recover her name — there is nothing left to recover it from. If one of them starts telling about her at a fire, that is a real and earned change to the map, and the hut may come back soft at the edges.
